title: Sample sidecar metadata
description: Draft v0.2 (#229). Written next to every generated WAV as <name>.json. Must be sufficient to re-render the identical file. schema_version 0.1 = kick sidecars as before (still valid, kick keeps 0.1); 0.2 is required for clap sidecars and not allowed for kick. Engine identity is per category (D-025): kick sidecars carry engine.name 'abeltongod-audio-engine' and its version; clap sidecars carry engine.name 'abeltongod-audio-engine-clap' and the clap engine's own version. A re-render compares only the name/version pair of its own category, so a byte change in one category never invalidates the sidecars of another (D-013 holds inside each category).

parameters.description: Exact <category>-params object used (kick-params for kick, clap-params for clap), including the variant's derived seed.

fundamental_hz.description: Pitched samples (kick). Optional; absent or null for non-pitched samples.

spectral_centroid_hz.description: v0.2, non-pitched samples (clap, later hat). Spectral centroid of the whole file, Hz.

hf_share_8k.description: v0.2. Share of the spectral energy above 8 kHz, 0 ... 1.

t60_ms.description: v0.2. Time from the peak until the envelope has fallen 60 dB, ms; null if it does not within the file.

rise_time_ms.description: v0.2. Onset rise time, 10 % to 90 % of the peak envelope, ms.
